<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#020617; --sky-50:#f0f9ff; --gray-50:#f9fafb; --gray-200:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#38bdf8; --text:#0f172a; --text-soft:#475569;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:#fff; line-height:1.55; margin:0;

       background:radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 50% -10%, #0b1220 0%, var(--navy) 60%);}
  h1{font-family:'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1.1; margin:0;}
  .wrap{max-width:640px; padding:48px 24px; text-align:center;}
  .code{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-weight:700; font-size:88px; letter-spacing:-.02em;
        background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff, #7dd3fc); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; line-height:1;}

  p{color:#cbd5e1; font-size:17px; margin:0 auto 32px; max-width:520px;}
  .actions{display:flex; gap:14px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:36px;}
  .pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 28px;

        transition:transform .15s ease;}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .pill-primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy);}
  .pill-outline{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35); color:#fff;}
  .links{font-size:14px; color:#94a3b8;}
  .links a{color:#e2e8f0; text-decoration:none; margin:0 10px; white-space:nowrap;}
  .links a:hover{color:var(--accent); text-decoration:underline;}
  @media(max-width:520px){ .code{font-size:64px;} h1{font-size:24px;} }
